body:
This is the release of opam 2.6.1.

Binaries and full archive are signed by the [opam dev team](https://opam.ocaml.org/opam-dev-pubkey.pgp) (fingerprint `92C5 26AE 50DF 3947 0EB2 911B ED4C F1CA 67CB AA92`).
To verify the authenticity of one of these files, run the following commands:
```
curl -fsSLO https://opam.ocaml.org/opam-dev-pubkey.pgp
gpg --import opam-dev-pubkey.pgp
gpg --verify *.sig
```

Please see our [blog post](https://opam.ocaml.org/blog/opam-2-6-1) for more details and the upgrade instructions.

[Changelog](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/blob/2.6.1/CHANGES):

## Changes
### Regression fixes
* Fix the depexts installation on `opam install --deps` when the system packages already exist in a repository [#7158 @kit-ty-kate - fix #7153]

### Improvements
* Add support for using git repositories owned by another local user [#6980 @kit-ty-kate - fix #6963]
* Use `/dev/null` on both Unix and Windows when setting `GIT_CONFIG_*` (works around a bug in Git-for-Windows 2.56.0.windows.1) [#7085 @kit-ty-kate]

### Miscellaneous
* Upgrade the "lockfile" with checkseum.0.5.4 and decompress.1.6.1 [#7172 @kit-ty-kate]
* Improve and extend the testsuite [#7158 #6980 @kit-ty-kate @rjbou]

## API updates
### `opam-repository`
* `OpamGit`: git calls now will all carry git config `safe.directory=.` (current directory) [#6980 @kit-ty-kate - fix #6963]

### `opam-state`
* `OpamSwitchState.update_sys_packages` (new in 2.6.0) was removed in favour of the already existing `update_package_metadata` or `update_pin` functions [#7158 @kit-ty-kate]
